spec.loader: scripts/panel_screen.py (opt-in; every other leg still reads e27.load_universe() unmodified)
spec.books: ladder5 = E39 engine call on the five ladder members; era spread = E41 ladder5 vs wide_topN on the full calendar

honest: the screen repairs arithmetic impossibility only: a flagged ETF print may be genuine (ETF daily limits differ from the 10%/20% stock band), so 'neutralise' is a sensitivity face, not a corrected truth

three columns are published for that reason: neutralise_int repairs only the prints whose price ratio lands on an integer (a share ratio with no announcement feed), neutralise repairs every adjacent print, drop removes the name -- the range between them bounds the correction
a slashed >30% sequence may need more than one event to clear; the loader applies every adjacent event it finds, and the report lists them
the screened book is not a pre-registration and books no trial: it is the same descriptive face replayed from a different input
drop mode changes the universe (n and eligibility), so its delta mixes the correction with a composition change; neutralise isolates it

gapped prints are deliberately not repaired -- a resumption after suspension can be a real market print, and on this panel both ladder5 corporate actions sit behind a suspension bar, which is why the ladder column does not move at all (ladder_member_prints shows each one)
descriptive census only: no gate, no verdict, no ledger booking, trial 0

the era spread is a book return, so unlike the churn sleeve it moves with the whole price path: a repair that only touches one era's entrants shows up here as a level shift, not as a composition change
only integer-ratio prints inside the session limit are repaired; a real resumption that lands on an integer ratio is repaired too, which is why the untouched column stays published
no arm here is a corrected truth and none is registered: ledger +0, trial 0, gate none
